Title: NETMESSAGE:First - Gear up, and then re-group at teleport room for transport
Translation: 首先 - 装备好，然后在传送室重新集结以进行传送

Title: NETMESSAGE:One at a time through the tp please...
Translation: 请每次一人通过传送点...

Title: NETMESSAGE:The APC is at the end of the loading dock, though we won't leave untill all Xeno are dead...
Translation: APC在装卸码头尽头，不过我们直到所有异形都死了才会离开...

Title: NETMESSAGE:Dock is done, APC Is waiting at the top of the ramp...
Translation: 码头处理完毕，APC在坡道顶端等待...
